top_signals.title: Gold Set for Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed, AI Selloff
top_signals.summary: Gold fell and was heading for the biggest weekly decline since March, as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate cuts and a selloff in AI stocks pushed investors to sell the metal to cover losses.
